entry_state: The language separates preserved Core 0 teaching syntax from proposed portable records and compilation. Exact values, unknowns, contexts, dependency identity and capability checks give the earlier mathematics enforceable boundaries. The debt listing retains a shared continuous family and posting rules require explicit applicability; the discussion of alternatives and evidence updates continues on the next page.
exit_state: Chapter 7 encodes contextual values, shared alternatives, restricted posting, versioned modules and typed failures. New evidence, revised views and posterior updates remain separate; migrations cannot conceal changed recognition meaning. The next chapter must put these declarations into reconstruction and execution procedures while preserving unresolved inputs and distinct failure outcomes.
findings: Alternative readings inherit parent constraints, linked treatment choices remain joint, and revised evidence views are distinct from likelihood-based reweighting.
Module extension points do not permit package load order to override mandatory standards. Typed plugin references avoid arbitrary embedded host-language code.
The diagnostic table assigns different recovery actions to context errors, missing evidence, infeasibility, unsupported treatment and numerical incompleteness; none silently becomes zero.
The two final pages are sparse but coherent: module semantics and diagnostic recovery each have a complete unit. No new confirmed defect.

chapters/06-language.tex:section:5.entry_belief: Rules and shared symbols can represent conditional financial interpretations.
chapters/06-language.tex:section:5.open_question: How do alternatives and later evidence change a model without discarding its history?
chapters/06-language.tex:section:5.parent_contribution: The section defines inherited constraints, joint choice relations and revised evidence views.
chapters/06-language.tex:section:5.belief_update: Narrowing compatible histories is distinct from changing the evidence basis or updating probability.
chapters/06-language.tex:section:5.exit_question: How do modules preserve these meanings across versions and extensions?
chapters/06-language.tex:section:5.removal_verdict: Omission would permit an alternative to remove inconvenient constraints or reweight itself implicitly.
chapters/06-language.tex:section:5.swap_verdict: It follows applicability because interpretation choices affect the accounting conditions under which rules operate.
chapters/06-language.tex:section:5.entry_verdict: The opening states that children add to their parent's constraints and carry reasons and supporting/opposing evidence.
chapters/06-language.tex:section:5.exit_verdict: Rejected branches remain historically considered with the evidence that rejected them.
chapters/06-language.tex:section:5.promise_verdict: Shared treatment variables preserve dependencies rather than taking an unjustified Cartesian product.
chapters/06-language.tex:section:5.distinct_contribution_verdict: It connects source revisions and structural alternatives without conflating either with Bayesian reweighting.

chapters/06-language.tex:section:6.entry_belief: A model's semantics depend on rules, evidence and linked alternatives.
chapters/06-language.tex:section:6.open_question: How can reusable packages and version changes preserve or explicitly change that meaning?
chapters/06-language.tex:section:6.parent_contribution: The section defines package scope, IR node identity, plugin references and migration obligations.
chapters/06-language.tex:section:6.belief_update: Standard, industry and company packages have bounded roles; a recognition-policy change creates a new model version.
chapters/06-language.tex:section:6.exit_question: What diagnostic should an implementation return when these obligations cannot be satisfied?
chapters/06-language.tex:section:6.removal_verdict: Removal would leave package order or syntax migration free to change financial semantics silently.
chapters/06-language.tex:section:6.swap_verdict: It follows alternatives and precedes errors so admissible extensions and failures have a stable referent.
chapters/06-language.tex:section:6.entry_verdict: Package namespace, dependencies, dates and jurisdiction establish applicability before override limits.
chapters/06-language.tex:section:6.exit_verdict: The final paragraph distinguishes syntax-only migration from changed recognition meaning.
chapters/06-language.tex:section:6.promise_verdict: The IR avoids executable host-language text and uses versioned typed plugin signatures.
chapters/06-language.tex:section:6.distinct_contribution_verdict: It separates serialization version, language version and accounting-standard edition.

chapters/06-language.tex:section:7.entry_belief: The compiler and runtime may reject a declaration for several substantively different reasons.
chapters/06-language.tex:section:7.open_question: How can callers recover without misreading failure as a financial result?
chapters/06-language.tex:section:7.parent_contribution: The diagnostic table associates typed failures with source/context information and appropriate next actions.
chapters/06-language.tex:section:7.belief_update: Missing evidence, conflict, unsupported treatment and numerical failure retain distinct outcomes rather than a generic fallback.
chapters/06-language.tex:section:7.exit_question: What end-to-end procedure carries these distinctions through reconstruction and execution?

chapters/06-language.tex:section:7.swap_verdict: It concludes the language chapter after the meanings whose violations it diagnoses.
